time_note: Declared after two original whole-face views; timestamp is approximate declaration time, not first pixel time.

picture.reading_direction: native bottom-to-top within each row; native left-to-right across parallel rows
picture.order_basis: Geometric order in CW90 reading pose: upper block then lower block, each top-to-bottom. Exact row/group extents to be determined from observed ink; no values.

address.order_basis: Ordinary printed heading then handwriting top-to-bottom; stamp/postmark/nontext separately.
